d: China’s economy is showing fresh signs of weakness ahead of the APEC leaders’ meeting in Shenzhen. Retail sales rose just 0.4% in October compared with a year earlier. Fixed-asset investment fell 8.1% in the first ten months of 2026, while industrial output growth slowed to 4.8%. Together, the numbers point to weak consumer demand, softer investment and slowing factory activity. That leaves China increasingly dependent on foreign markets.
